components.name: Primary Pill
components.description: The one main action on a screen, usually the next step.
components.html: <button class="ds-pill">Next: End <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:var(--s2); min-height:var(--tap); padding:0 var(--s5); border:0; border-radius:999px; font-family: var(--font); font-weight:700; font-size:var(--fs-md); background:var(--primary-bg); color:var(--primary-text); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-pill:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Pill
components.description: Other actions next to a primary pill.
components.css: .ds-pill-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:var(--tap); padding:0 var(--s5); border:0; border-radius:999px; font-family: var(--font); font-weight:700; font-size:var(--fs-md); background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-pill-secondary:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-pill-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Counter Row
components.description: Signature control: label, outline minus, big number, alliance-filled plus.

components.css: .ds-counter { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr var(--tap) 4.5rem var(--tap-lg); align-items:center; gap:var(--s2); padding:var(--s3) var(--s4); background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-counter-label { font-weight:650; font-size:var(--fs-md); } .ds-counter-hint { font-size:var(--fs-sm); color:var(--text-3); } .ds-counter-value { font-size:var(--fs-num); font-weight:800; font-stretch:75%; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums; letter-spacing:-0.01em; line-height:1; text-align:center; } .ds-round { display:grid; place-items:center; width:var(--tap); height:var(--tap); border-radius:50%; border:2px solid var(--control-line); background:none; color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-round-add { width:var(--tap-lg); height:var(--tap-lg); border:0; background:var(--red); color:var(--on-alliance); } .ds-round:active { transform:scale(0.92); } .ds-round:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:2px; }

components.css: .ds-head { background:var(--red); color:var(--on-alliance); padding:var(--s1) var(--s3) var(--s3); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-head-row { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:48px; } .ds-head-meta { flex:1; font-size:var(--fs-sm); font-weight:600; } .ds-head-pts { text-align:right; } .ds-head-pts-v { font-size:var(--fs-2xl); font-weight:800; font-stretch:75%; line-height:1; } .ds-head-pts-l { font-size:var(--fs-xs); font-weight:600; } .ds-head-team { font-size:var(--fs-hero); font-weight:800; font-stretch:75%; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; letter-spacing:-0.01em; line-height:0.95; padding:0 var(--s1) var(--s3); } .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:var(--s1); padding:var(--s1); border-radius:999px; background:rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22); } .ds-tabs button { flex:1; min-height:var(--tap); border:0; border-radius:999px; background:none; font-family: var(--font); font-size:var(--fs-sm); font-weight:700; color:var(--on-alliance); cursor:pointer; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { background:var(--on-alliance); color:var(--red); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Yes/No, ratings and pick-one options; the selected segment takes the alliance colour.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:flex; gap:var(--s1); padding:var(--s1); border-radius:16px; background:var(--surface); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-seg button { flex:1; min-width:var(--tap); min-height:var(--tap); border:0; border-radius:12px; background:none; font:inherit; font-weight:700; color:var(--text-2); cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background:var(--red); color:var(--on-alliance); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Filled field for team and match numbers and notes.
components.css: .ds-input { display:block; width:100%; min-height:var(--tap); padding:0 var(--s4); border-radius:var(--radius); border:2px solid transparent; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font-family: var(--font); font-size:var(--fs-lg); font-weight:600; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--text-3); font-weight:500; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--text); outline:none; }

components.name: List Link
components.description: Tappable Surface row on the home screen, with a count at right.
components.css: .ds-list-link { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:var(--s3); min-height:var(--tap-lg); padding:0 var(--s4); border-radius:var(--radius); background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font-family: var(--font); font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; } .ds-count { margin-left:auto; color:var(--text-2); font-weight:600; } .ds-list-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Alliance Badge
components.description: Small alliance-coloured square in the saved matches list, with the match number.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-grid; place-items:center; width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--red); color:var(--on-alliance); font-family: var(--font); font-weight:800; font-size:var(--fs-sm); }

narrative.overview:
Offline Scout is a counter you hold in the stands. A scout watches a robot, not the phone, so the screen is built to be hit with a thumb and read in half a second: huge condensed numbers, round buttons, and one strong colour that says which alliance you are watching.

The ground is near-black (or plain white in the light theme) with two slightly raised grey layers. The alliance colour, red or blue, is the only real colour. It fills the match header and every add button. Everything else is white, grey, or black. There is one font, Archivo, used two ways: squeezed and heavy for numbers and headings, normal width for words.

It is meant to feel bold and sporty, like a music app's now-playing screen, not like a school form. It turns down the white form with grey labels and the long scrolling page.
keyCharacteristics: One committed colour: the alliance (red or blue), everything else is neutral.
Numbers are the loudest thing on screen.
Every tap target is a pill or a circle, at least 56px.
Flat surfaces; depth comes from lighter grey layers, not shadows.
Light and dark themes share the same layout; only the colours swap.

rules.name: The One Colour Rule
rules.body: The alliance colour is the only saturated colour on a scouting screen. Don't add a second accent; use neutrals.

rules.name: The Not By Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Wherever the alliance colour appears as meaning, the alliance is also written out in text ("Red alliance", the badge letter).

rules.name: The Squeeze For Numbers Rule
rules.body: Condensed width (75%) is for numbers and big headings only. Words a scout reads, like labels and buttons, stay at normal width.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes uses tabular, lining digits so it doesn't jump sideways when it counts up.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow except the confirm sheet, which floats above everything.

dos: **Do** use the alliance colour for the add button, the header, and the selected choice, and nothing decorative.
**Do** keep every in-match control at least 56px, and the add button 64px.
**Do** set numbers in condensed Archivo 800 with tabular digits.
**Do** take every colour, size and space from tokens.css so both themes keep working.
**Do** keep the reduced-motion version: colour flash stays, scaling goes.
**Do** write the alliance in words next to the colour.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent colour to scouting screens.
**Don't** use shadows on cards or rows; use the Surface layers.
**Don't** use emoji as icons; use the inline SVG set.
**Don't** add team colours or logos; the app stays team-neutral.
**Don't** add hover-only effects; everything must work by touch.
